one: Autonomous robots II: RL/optimal control, manipulation, imitation learning, human-robot interaction, and system architecture.
pos: CS 237B is the advanced follow-up to CS 237A, shifting from mobility to learning new skills and physical interaction. It covers RL and optimal control, contact dynamics, grasping/manipulation, imitation learning, human intent inference, and system architecture validation, implemented on a mobile manipulation platform.
topics: **RL and optimal control**: MDPs, LQR, policy gradients
**Contact and manipulation**: grasping, non-prehensile manipulation, force control
**Imitation learning**: behavior cloning, DAgger, inverse RL
assess: Assignments plus a project on a mobile manipulation platform. Check the current syllabus for details.
who: Robot manipulation, embodied AI, and human-robot collaboration.
tips: Take CS 237A and CS 234 first. Pair contact dynamics with physics simulation.
note: Not offered in the 2026–27 ExploreCourses listing.
